svg.title: Emotion & Feeling Wheel
svg.desc: Six core emotions, 34 secondary emotions, and 68 specific feelings. All wheel labels read radially outward, with their first letter toward the center. Anger: Rage (Hate, Hostile); Exasperated (Agitated, Frustrated); Irritable (Annoyed, Aggravated); Envy (Resentful, Jealous); Disgust (Contempt, Revolted). Sadness: Suffering (Agony, Hurt); Sadness (Depressed, Sorrow); Disappointed (Dismayed, Displeased); Shameful (Regretful, Guilty); Neglected (Isolated, Lonely); Despair (Grief, Powerless). Surprise: Stunned (Shocked, Dismayed); Confused (Disillusioned, Perplexed); Amazed (Astonished, Awe-struck); Overcome (Speechless, Astounded); Moved (Stimulated, Touched). Joy: Content (Pleased, Satisfied); Happy (Amused, Delighted); Cheerful (Jovial, Blissful); Proud (Triumphant, Illustrious); Optimistic (Eager, Hopeful); Enthusiastic (Excited, Zeal); Elation (Euphoric, Jubilation); Enthralled (Enchanted, Rapture). Love: Affectionate (Romantic, Fondness); Longing (Sentimental, Attracted); Desire (Passion, Infatuation); Tenderness (Caring, Compassionate); Peaceful (Relieved, Satisfied). Fear: Scared (Frightened, Helpless); Terror (Panic, Hysterical); Insecure (Inferior, Inadequate); Nervous (Worried, Anxious); Horror (Mortified, Dread). Based on the supplied Junto Institute reference.
